article.title: Tópicos colgados en mandarín: una categoría debatida
article.part: Información y discurso avanzado — 信息與進階篇章
article.chapter: Tema, foco, elipsis y cadenas referenciales — 主題、焦點、省略與指稱鏈

claims.summary: Pan and Hu propose semantic-pragmatic licensing of some Mandarin topics through a non-empty intersection between a topic-denoted set and a set generated by a variable associated with the comment.
Huang and Ting argue for a non-dangling analysis and reanalyze alleged dangling-topic types as subjects, structurally dependent topics, sentential adverbials, or reduced prepositional phrases.
Huang and Ting analyze fire-topic examples as context-dependent, including a temporal-adverbial analysis, while Pan and Hu use a closely related fire example to argue for pragmatic causal licensing.
The cited authors present competing analyses of Mandarin topic constructions; the entry reports the dispute and does not treat either framework as an uncontested rule specific to Taiwan Mandarin.

links.notes: The authors distinguish syntactic and semantic-pragmatic topic licensing and state the set-intersection condition.
The paper identifies opposing approaches and argues for the non-dangling analysis, giving its reanalysis categories.
Huang and Ting discuss the xingkui fire example and analyze the short variant as a temporal NP adverbial; they also compare complete-discourse variants.
Pan and Hu discuss closely related fire-topic examples and analyze causal/pragmatic licensing by a set generated in context.
